summary: Nagamine Manufacturing specializes in precision ceramics and metal processing, offering integrated production capabilities from mold design to finished products. Their ceramic nozzles and metal porous materials are particularly relevant for the handling and transfer of electronic components and IC chips in semiconductor applications.

Metal porous materials for precision part transfer
Conductive ceramic materials with adjustable conductivity
